table.name: TLGNS_SAP_MATERIAL_ALT_UOM
table.description: Alternative units of measurements for a given material. Received from SAP, n per Material.

column.name: UOM_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_uom_bs. The alternative unit of measurement. SAP: material_unit_measure (MARM) / MEINH, must match with the Logon reference data table.

column.name: NUMERATOR_FOR_CONVERSION
column.description: Multiplier in respect to base unit tlgns_sap_material.base_uom_cd. SAP: material_unit_measure (MARM) / UMREZ.

column.name: DENOMINATOR_FOR_CONVERSION
column.description: Divisor in respect to base unit tlngs_sap_material.base_uom_cd. SAP: material_unit_measure (MARM) / UMREN.
